2610.07860.title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
2610.07860.paper_summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.
2610.07860.paper_summary_zh: 多代理系統越來越多地被部署於複雜的知識工作中，但它們的協調層仍然在很大程度上是無記憶的：每個新任務都是從頭開始進行分解、分配和執行，無法從先前成功執行中獲益。我們提出了WorkflowOps，一個多代理工作流程協調框架，該框架從歷史工作流程中學習代理協作的先驗知識，並根據需求擴展其代理池以滿足新的能力要求。我們的方法引入了三個耦合機制。首先，轉移概率矩陣捕捉過去工作流程中成對代理協作的頻率，並在DAG工作流程構建過程中通過層內排序優化、概率閾值邊建議和傳遞性簡化應用這些作為軟指導，以最大化並行性。其次，一個以充分性為驅動的代理創建循環通過語義匹配分數檢測能力缺口，通過LLM生成專門的代理，並同時將它們注入協作矩陣中，這樣新創建的代理就可以立即使用預測的協作先驗。第三，一種分層語義匹配策略使用預訓練的句子嵌入進行快速、確定性的能力匹配作為第一步，僅在低信心情況下調用LLM驗證，從而與純LLM方法相比，將LLM路由調用減少超過80%。在混合代碼、數學和問答套件上的實驗顯示，WorkflowOps在最近的工作流程構建基線上提高了端到端通過率，對於結構化、可分解的任務，過去的代理交接模式轉移帶來了最大的增益。
